Fixed the regression in sqlparse/sql.py: Token.is_child_of had an inverted comparison (`!=` instead of `==`), which meant it always returned True except when the token's parent was literally the same object being compared against itself incorrectly - actually it returned True for tokens that were NOT children, and False for tokens that WERE children (the opposite of its docstring). Changed `self.parent != other` to `self.parent == other` so it correctly returns True when `other` is this token's direct parent. Now verifying with a quick inline test.
